title: Enhance Create Studio with more templates/textures/fonts, richer editing, and working downloads

requirements.text: Expand Create Studio’s procedural generator and preset catalog so users have more high-quality design variations, templates, and textures when generating Invitation/Birthday/Wedding cards.

quotes: In create studio add more best designs,texture fonts, template

acceptanceCriteria: In Create Studio, clicking “Generate Designs” produces at least 6 distinct previews (not just 3) for the same input.
The preview variations differ in layout and visual treatment (e.g., template/layout, background, texture) rather than only title/id.
The editor preset catalog in the UI includes additional Template options and additional Texture options beyond the current lists in frontend/src/components/createStudio/editorPresets.ts.
The additional presets are selectable in the editor and visibly change the preview output after applying changes.

requirements.text: Add font family selection to the Create Studio editor and ensure font selection is applied to the rendered design preview for generated cards (Invitation/Birthday/Wedding and other occasions).
acceptanceCriteria: The editor UI (DesignEditorPanel) includes a new control for choosing a font family (English UI labels).
Selecting a font family and applying changes updates the generated preview image (SVG) so the font style is visibly different.
DesignCustomization and related types are extended to persist the selected font family per design (frontend/src/components/createStudio/types.ts).
If no font is selected, a sensible default is used and existing designs continue to render without errors.

requirements.text: Implement a functional “Download” action for each generated design so users can download the final customized Invitation/Birthday/Wedding card design after editing.

quotes: after clicking generate design we can edit and customize invitation,birthday,wedding cards and then download that

acceptanceCriteria: The “Download” button in the generated design card grid (frontend/src/pages/CreateStudioPage.tsx) triggers a real download instead of doing nothing.
Downloaded file name is readable and includes the occasion and/or design title (e.g., "Birthday-Design-1.png").
The downloaded content reflects the latest applied customizations (template/texture/emojis/font, etc.) for that design.
If download fails for any reason, the user sees a clear English error toast/message and can retry.

requirements.text: Add a small set of additional Create Studio customization controls (“more things”) that improve invitation/card editing beyond the current template/style/texture/emojis, and ensure they affect the preview output when applied.
acceptanceCriteria: The design editor includes at least two additional customization controls beyond the current ones (Templates/Style/Texture/Emojis), with English labels.
Applying these additional controls results in a visible change to the design preview after “Apply Changes.”
New customization fields are persisted per design in the in-memory generatedPreviews state so reopening the editor shows the current selections.
No regressions: existing controls (template/style/texture/emojis) still work as before.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep all changes within the existing React + TypeScript + Tailwind + React Query stack; do not introduce Next.js/Vue/Angular or external services.
Do not add new backend canisters/services; Create Studio enhancements should remain frontend-only unless a clear backend dependency is introduced in a follow-up request.
nonGoals: Building a true AI/LLM-based image generator (keep using the existing deterministic/procedural generator approach).
Adding external font CDNs or third-party design/editing SDKs.
Persisting generated designs to backend storage or adding a full “My Designs” save/share system as part of this request (only generation → edit → download is in scope).
